sections.heading: Matteo Ruggeri Transfer Status
paragraphs: According to The New York Times, Aston Villa is closing in on a deal for Matteo Ruggeri. The reported value of the deal is €20m.

sections.heading: Agreement for Next Signing
paragraphs: Football365 reports that Romano has revealed an 'agreement' for Aston Villa's next signing. This report comes alongside a new timeline for the Jackson deal.

sections.heading: Atlético Madrid Update
paragraphs: Get Spanish Football News states that Atlético Madrid has agreed to an ‘imminent’ switch to the Premier League.
